task.instruction: Recommend a review-queue policy for clear rule violations and context-dependent disputes.
task.deliverable: A policy recommendation, appeal invariant, and evidence grounding.

evidence.content: A synthetic moderation due-process rule retains an appeal path for every removal because context-dependent disputes cannot be conclusively resolved by the initial threshold alone.
Synthetic queue data contain 760 clear duplicates, 180 clear prohibited items, and 95 context-dependent disputes.
Fixed thresholds agree 97% on clear items but split reviewers evenly on satire, quotation, and reclaimed language.

A.content: When repeatability and auditability dominate, make the decision sequence and required checks explicit.

B.content: When conditions vary in consequential ways, preserve bounded judgment to adapt the decision to observed context.

irrelevant.content: Use one capitalization style for all section headings.
